responseContract.numericRule: if all three counts exist, curravacnt + parkingcnt must equal maxcnt (tolerance 1)
responseContract.missingOneNumericField: may derive exactly one missing count; mark as derived
responseContract.conflictingValues: invalid; never overwrite source values to make them consistent

pagination.policy: do not paginate until the authenticated API specification confirms request parameter names

releaseReadiness.paginationRule: if totalCount is present, the one-call probe must return itemCount >= totalCount; otherwise release is blocked until pagination parameters are documented
releaseReadiness.reason: PlugPark cron must build a complete realtime snapshot, not silently publish a single parking lot or partial page
